Welcome to the Grafana Cloud learning path that shows you how to turn on auto-apply for a segment, choose a mode, and use the pages where you can enable it.

Adaptive Metrics looks at how you use your metrics and suggests changes to how much detail you keep for each one. Each change is a recommendation. Auto-apply applies the new recommendations your mode allows for a segment, without manual review. A segment is a group of your metrics. A label is a name and value pair attached to a metric, such as `service="checkout"`. Each metric name with one set of labels is a series, a list of values recorded over time. The Default segment holds the series that aren't assigned to a named segment.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Turn auto-apply on for the Default segment from Overview, and choose **Coverage-first** or **Cost-first**

The other places are options. Use one when it applies on your stack:

- Turn it on for multiple segments from Overview, with one mode for the selection
- Turn it on for a single segment on Segments, and choose the same mode there
- Turn it on after applying all recommendations on Metrics, and choose the same mode in that prompt

## Before you begin

Before you turn auto-apply on, make sure that:

- You have already applied recommendations yourself.
- Exemptions are in place for metrics you cannot afford to lose. An exemption keeps a metric, or a label, out of recommendations. Refer to [Use exemptions](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/create-exemptions/).
- You need **Admin**. That's the permission to turn auto-apply on, not your job title.
- You use the segment you already have, such as Default. Refer to [Configure segmentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-metrics/additional-configuration/adaptive-metrics-rule-segmentation/) when you want to add a named segment. You can stay on Default. The later steps are options for a stack that already has named segments, or for a segment that still has auto-apply off.

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

We understand you might want to explore other capabilities not strictly on this path. We'll provide you opportunities where it makes sense.
